title: C++ Studio
description: From "I have modified a Python script once" to designing, debugging, testing, profiling and shipping serious C++ software — by building real projects with real tools.

tracks.title: Track 0 — The Development Environment
tracks.description: Source files, the compiler, the linker, diagnostics, CMake and the debugger. Short, but everything else stands on it.

tracks.title: Track 1 — C++ Foundations
tracks.description: Types, expressions, loops, functions, strings, vectors, structs and references, headers and unit tests — taught by building small, tested tools.

tracks.title: Track 2 — Memory, Lifetime and Ownership
tracks.description: Stack and heap, object lifetime, constructors and destructors, ownership, RAII and smart pointers — with AddressSanitizer catching every memory mistake. More lessons coming: move semantics, smart pointers in depth, a container with iterators.

tracks.title: Track 3 — The C++ Language
tracks.description: Classes and invariants, composition and inheritance, polymorphism, lambdas, and modern C++ (optional, variant, expected, span, ranges, concepts) — including when not to use them.

tracks.title: Track 4 — The Standard Library, Data Structures and Algorithms
tracks.description: Containers, iterators, algorithms and complexity — discovered by measuring real programs, not memorised from a table.

tracks.title: Track 5 — Software Engineering
tracks.description: Git workflows, testable design, GoogleTest, static analysis, sanitizers, formatting, CI, packaging and releases.

tracks.title: Track 6 — Systems Programming and Operating Systems
tracks.description: Processes, address spaces, file descriptors, pipes, threads, mutexes, condition variables, thread pools and virtual memory — on Windows, Linux and macOS.

tracks.title: Track 7 — Networking
tracks.description: Sockets, TCP and UDP, serialization, protocol design, asynchronous I/O and concurrent servers.

tracks.title: Track 8 — Graphics: Fundamentals, OpenGL and Vulkan
tracks.description: Vectors, matrices, cameras, shaders and meshes; then OpenGL for concepts, then Vulkan where the machinery is explicit.

tracks.title: Track 9 — Game Engine and Games
tracks.description: Entities, components and systems, input, physics, resources and scenes — then cache locality and data-oriented design when 50,000 objects get slow.

tracks.title: Track 10 — Advanced C++
tracks.description: Templates, type traits, concepts, metaprogramming, allocators, object layout and vtables, exceptions, coroutines, atomics and the memory model, undefined behaviour.
